title: Hearing on mental health services for veterans and military families
summary: The Council's Committees on Veterans and on Mental Health and Substance Use held a joint oversight hearing examining mental health and substance use conditions among the roughly 122,700 veterans living in New York City. Testimony covered treatment options like therapy, animal-assisted therapy and emerging psychedelic treatments, along with barriers to care such as unmet needs, distrust of treatment effectiveness and difficulty navigating benefits. The hearing also considered Resolution 493-2026, which would declare April 7 as White Star Family Day in New York City.
